At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe building engineering is more than systems and structures, it’s about powering progress and enabling innovation. As part of HDR’s Building Engineering Services Group, you’ll help design the critical infrastructure that supports the digital age and shapes the spaces where people work, connect, and thrive. From high-performance data centers driving the future of AI to dynamic commercial environments, your work will directly support technological advancement, sustainability, and human experience. We bring together mechanical, electrical, structural, and civil engineering experts to solve complex design challenges with precision, creativity, and collaboration. Whether you're optimizing energy efficiency, integrating resilient systems, or engineering the backbone of next-generation facilities, your contributions will help define the future of the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to lead innovation, engineer impact, and build a legacy of excellence.

, you will be in charge of growing and overseeing our building engineering service sector for the North
Central region
of HDR, overseeing approximately a five-state area in the US. More specific duties include:

Develop, implement and maintain an effective regional business group program, including business development strategies, new business pursuits, monitor staffing levels, foster technical/specialty services, quality assurance program, production methods and standards, all within established goals and objectives of the company and business group.

Participate in alternative delivery risk reviews.

Assist in the identification and prioritization of regional strategic hires and in the recruiting of new candidates.
Review marketing forecasts (SNB and Booked) and staff alignment with backlog.
Ensure leaders in the region lead and actively participate in the annual planning process as required (alignment meetings and budgeting).
Add strong business skillset as the regional BG point of interface with Operations.
Committed to quality, improvement and HDR values.
Perform other duties as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven relationships within Building Engineering organizations within the region.
Applicable registrations and association activities.
Frequent travel required.
Position requires that the applicant resides within the South Central region or willing to relocate to an Area within the region.
Committed to quality improvement and HDR values.
Strong operations and client development skills.
Experience with alternative delivery contracting and risk management

Bachelor's degree in a Professional, Architecture, Engineering or closely related field
A minimum of 12 years experience in related field
Demonstrated experience with leading diverse teams
Works cooperatively with other regional business group directors, regional and local office managers, technical and marketing directors

added.title: Sr. Manager, Software Development, Prime Video
added.description:
Description

Prime Video operates one of the largest and most complex streaming infrastructures in the world, serving hundreds of millions of customers across live sports, movies, and TV in more than 240 countries and territories. Ensuring that this infrastructure scales predictably, runs efficiently, and protects customer privacy is foundational to the business. We are hiring a Senior Software Development Manager to own three of the most consequential infrastructure disciplines within Prime Video.

This leader will report directly to the Director of READI and be accountable for how Prime Video plans for scale, drives cost and resource efficiency across core compute and AI infrastructure, and upholds customer privacy as a first-class engineering discipline. This is a broad role that spans predictive capacity planning, deep infrastructure optimization, and privacy engineering — requiring a leader who is equally comfortable in a data-driven forecasting review, an architecture deep-dive on compute and GPU efficiency, and a privacy risk assessment with legal and security partners.

The successful candidate is a seasoned engineering leader who builds and develops high-performing teams, sets multi-year technical strategy, and delivers measurable results in ambiguous, high-scale environments. They will lead through other managers and senior engineers, influence peer organizations and partner teams across Prime Video and AWS, and represent Prime Video’s infrastructure posture to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities

PV Scale Forecasting & Capacity Assurance

Own the end-to-end discipline of forecasting demand and assuring capacity across Prime Video’s infrastructure footprint, ensuring the service scales reliably for both predictable growth and peak events (e.g., major live sports, tentpole launches, and global releases).

Own multi-year and event-based capacity models that translate business growth, content strategy, and traffic patterns into infrastructure demand across compute, storage, network, and CDN.

Lead capacity assurance for high-stakes live events, establishing headroom targets, load-testing regimes, and go/no-go readiness reviews with partner teams.

Build a forecasting practice grounded in data science and telemetry — improving forecast accuracy, quantifying confidence intervals, and reducing both over-provisioning waste and under-provisioning risk.

Partner on demand-planning and capacity-management processes with AWS, finance, and PV service teams so that capacity is secured ahead of need at the right cost.

Define the mechanisms (dashboards, reviews, and escalation paths) that give leadership confidence that Prime Video will scale for every moment that matters.

PV Infrastructure Efficiency (Core Compute & AI Infrastructure)

Drive infrastructure efficiency as a durable, measurable engineering discipline across Prime Video’s core compute fleet and its rapidly growing AI/ML infrastructure, materially improving unit economics while protecting reliability and performance.

Set the efficiency strategy and roadmap for core compute (CPU fleets, containerized services, memory/DRAM footprint) and AI infrastructure (GPU/accelerator fleets, training and inference platforms).

Drive down infrastructure cost-to-serve and improve utilization through right-sizing, fleet consolidation, hardware refresh strategy, and adoption of more efficient compute and runtimes.

Optimize the efficiency of AI/ML workloads — GPU utilization, training throughput, inference cost per request — partnering with science and platform teams to eliminate waste in one of PV’s fastest-growing spend areas.

Establish efficiency goals with clear metrics (utilization, cost per stream/request, DRAM and energy footprint) and instrument the fleet so gains are visible, attributable, and durable.

Lead zero-based capacity and efficiency reviews, and represent PV in senior compute-allocation and cost-optimization forums.

PV Privacy

Own privacy as a first-class engineering discipline for Prime Video infrastructure, ensuring that customer data is handled in accordance with Amazon’s privacy commitments and global regulatory obligations by design and by default.

Own the privacy engineering roadmap for PV infrastructure — data handling, minimization, retention, access controls, and auditability across the services and fleets in scope.

Embed privacy-by-design into capacity, compute, and AI infrastructure decisions, ensuring new systems and AI/ML workloads meet privacy requirements before launch.

Partner closely with Legal, Security, and central Privacy teams to translate regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR and regional privacy laws) into concrete engineering controls and mechanisms.

Build the mechanisms that detect, prevent, and remediate privacy risks — tooling, reviews, and metrics that make privacy posture measurable and continuously improving.

Champion a culture of privacy ownership across the team, raising the bar on how PV builds and operates infrastructure that customers trust.

About The Team

READI (Reliability, Efficiency, Availability, Defense & Integrity) is the Prime Video organization chartered to keep one of the world’s largest streaming services fast, efficient, resilient, and trustworthy. We sit at the intersection of infrastructure, operations, and customer trust — the team that ensures Prime Video scales for every tentpole launch and live event, spends every infrastructure dollar wisely, and protects customer data by design.

This role anchors three of READI’s most strategic charters — scale forecasting and capacity assurance, infrastructure efficiency across core compute and AI infrastructure, and privacy engineering. You will lead a team of managers and senior engineers, and partner daily with Prime Video service teams, AWS, Finance, Legal, Security, and central Privacy. The work is high-visibility and high-impact: our decisions show up in customer experience during the biggest moments of the year, in Prime Video’s cost structure, and in the trust customers place in how we handle their data.

We are a team that thinks long-term, dives deep on data, and holds a high bar. We invest in our people, promote from within, and give leaders room to set strategy and own outcomes end to end. If you are energized by hard technical problems at massive scale and by building teams that raise the bar, you will fit right in.

5+ years of engineering team management experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
12+ years of engineering experience
12+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with product and program management teams
Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

Does working on an innovative and transformational serverless database excite you? Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database with virtually unlimited scale, high availability, and zero infrastructure management. Our vision is to make Aurora DSQL the best database service offering for all types of workloads. This is a once in a generation opportunity to shape the future of databases and make history.

The Query Processing team of Aurora DSQL owns everything in the life cycle of a SQL statement like Parsing, Analysis (syntax and semantic), Rewriting, Planning (Optimizer) and Execution while providing customers access to observability metrics to help them understand their database performance better.

A successful candidate for this role is expected to have deep software engineering, project management, and people management skills. They must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven, and have the ability to deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment.

added.description:
Bring YOUR energy to Alliant Energy!

At Alliant Energy, our purpose is to serve customers and build stronger communities. We are passionate about powering beyond the market challenges of today, while powering what's next in energy. When our employees say "I am energy", it means they take pride in the work we do when disaster strikes, as well as all the days in between. We want you to be safe, happy and healthy. That's why we prioritize safety, offer volunteer opportunities and provide competitive pay, comprehensive health and retirement benefits, tuition reimbursement and paid time off.

Job Summary

The Head of Infrastructure Portfolio Management provides strategic leadership and oversight for Alliant Energy's electric and gas infrastructure development portfolio, overseeing the planning and execution of a multi-billion-dollar capital investment program across multiple states.

The role provides leadership for the development and delivery of complex infrastructure investments that advance the company's growth strategy while maintaining a strong focus on reliability, affordability, and operational excellence. This leader brings commercial and financial acumen to shape investment priorities, balance competing demands, and drive long-term value for customers, communities, and shareholders.

As a key enterprise leader, the Head of Infrastructure Portfolio Management influences strategic infrastructure, investment, and regulatory decisions while representing the organization in high-impact internal and external forums, including interactions with regulators, customers, community stakeholders, industry partners, investors, and the Board of Directors.

What You Will Do

Provide leadership for the development and execution of a multi-billion-dollar portfolio of major electric and gas infrastructure investments across multiple states, ensuring projects advance corporate strategy, strengthen system reliability, support customer affordability, and meet long-term infrastructure needs.

At Eftsure, we’re scaling our presence across the United States and looking for a VP or Senior Director - Global Head of Value Engineering

This is a 100% remote opportunity anywhere in the US
, working closely with our Sales team on strategic and enterprise opportunities.

If you’re commercially minded, financially savvy and love translating technology into a clear story around ROI, risk reduction and business value, this could be a great opportunity to join a growing global fintech.

About Eftsure

Eftsure is a fast-scaling SaaS fraud technology platform protecting B2B payments through real-time vendor verification and payment protection. In a world of increasingly sophisticated cybercrime and payment fraud, we help businesses transact securely and avoid paying the wrong people.

As we continue to expand internationally, our goal is to become the Security Standard for B2B payments.

About The Role

As our Value Engineer, you’ll partner closely with Account Executives to build the financial and commercial case for Eftsure.

You’ll work directly with prospects and customers to understand their current environment, quantify risk and opportunity, and demonstrate the measurable value Eftsure can deliver. That means taking platform capabilities and translating them into the language of CFOs, treasury teams and senior finance leaders - from ROI and risk reduction through to operational and financial impact.

This isn’t a traditional technical pre-sales role. We’re looking for someone who can sit at the intersection of finance, technology and enterprise sales, helping customers understand not just what Eftsure does, but why the investment makes commercial sense .

You’ll also have the opportunity to help build and shape Eftsure’s Value Engineering capability as we scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

Partner with Account Executives on strategic and enterprise opportunities, developing compelling and quantified business cases that translate Eftsure’s capabilities into financial outcomes.
Build and maintain value calculators, ROI models and tools that enable meaningful value conversations earlier in the sales cycle.
Work directly with prospects and internal stakeholders to understand their current state, business challenges and future needs.
Present findings, recommendations and business cases to C-Suite, senior management, treasury and finance stakeholders.
Translate technical capabilities into clear, credible and measurable business value.
Partner with Customer Success to track KPIs, monitor value and demonstrate post-sale value realization.
Contribute to thought leadership through presentations, webinars and content around payment fraud risk and financial controls.
Help build and continuously improve Eftsure’s Value Engineering frameworks, tools and processes as the function grows.

What we’re looking for

You’ll bring 3+ years’ experience in Value Engineering, Value Consulting, financial or treasury management, or a related pre-sales function - ideally within B2B SaaS or fintech.

You’ll Also Have

Strong financial acumen and confidence discussing the metrics, risks and priorities that matter to CFOs and finance leaders.
Experience building ROI models and quantified business cases.
Excellent client-facing communication and relationship-building skills.
Confidence presenting to C-Suite and senior stakeholders.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills and broader proficiency across Microsoft Office.
The ability to take complex or technical platform capabilities and turn them into a simple, compelling financial story.
Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
A self-motivated, adaptable mindset and an interest in building processes and frameworks from the ground up.
A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting or a related field.

This is an opportunity to join Eftsure at an exciting stage of our US growth and have genuine influence over how we demonstrate value to the market.

You’ll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing and Finance, have exposure to senior customer stakeholders, and play an important role in helping strategic customers understand the financial impact of protecting their B2B payments.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to combine financial acumen, commercial strategy and technology while helping businesses protect themselves from payment fraud, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

The Vice President of Applications is a senior technology and transformation leader responsible for the strategy, delivery, optimization, and support of enterprise clinical and revenue cycle applications across the health system. This role provides executive oversight for the electronic health record platform, with a required depth of experience in Epic/Cerner or Cerner (Oracle Health), as well as adjacent clinical, operational, and revenue cycle systems that enable safe, efficient, integrated, and digitally enabled care delivery.

The VP will serve as a key partner to clinical, operational, financial, and technology leaders to transform workflows, improve clinician and patient experience, strengthen revenue cycle performance, and accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence, automation, and data-driven capabilities. This leader will be accountable for aligning application strategy with enterprise priorities, ensuring reliable service delivery, and advancing measurable outcomes across quality, access, productivity, financial performance, and user satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Reporting Relationship and Key Partnerships

This position typically reports to the Chief Digital and Information Officer, Chief Information Officer, or equivalent senior executive. The role partners closely with the Chief Medical Information Officer, Chief Nursing Informatics Officer, Chief Financial Officer, revenue cycle leadership, operational executives, compliance, information security, data and analytics, enterprise project management, and vendor partners.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise applications portfolio supporting clinical care, revenue cycle, patient access, pharmacy, laboratory, imaging, interoperability, and other health system operations.

Provide executive oversight for Epic/Cerner strategy, governance, implementation, optimization, release management, upgrades, support, and adoption across clinical and revenue cycle domains.

Develop and execute a multiyear applications roadmap aligned with health system strategy, clinical transformation, financial stewardship, regulatory priorities, and digital innovation goals.

Partner with clinical, operational, and financial leaders to redesign workflows that reduce friction, improve safety and quality, enhance provider and caregiver experience, and support standardized, evidence-based care.

Advance revenue cycle transformation by optimizing Epic/Cerner and related platforms to improve registration, authorization, coding, charge capture, billing, denial prevention, collections, and overall financial performance.

Identify, prioritize, and deliver AI, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions that improve productivity, reduce manual work, strengthen decision support, and enable scalable operations.

Establish strong application governance, prioritization, and portfolio management practices that balance enterprise needs, operational demand, resource capacity, cybersecurity, compliance, and return on investment.

Ensure high-quality application service delivery, including incident management, problem resolution, service level performance, user support, change management, release readiness, and communication.

Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing applications organization with strong capabilities in Epic/Cerner, clinical informatics, revenue cycle systems, project delivery, vendor management, business analysis, testing, training, and customer service.

Collaborate with data, analytics, and AI leaders to embed actionable insights, predictive models, automation, and responsible AI practices into clinical and operational workflows.

Oversee vendor relationships, contract performance, platform roadmaps, and partner accountability for Epic/Cerner and other strategic application partners.

Maintain compliance with healthcare regulations, privacy and security requirements, documentation standards, change control processes, and audit expectations.

Measure and communicate outcomes using clear performance indicators tied to clinical effectiveness, revenue cycle value, application reliability, adoption, optimization, and user satisfaction.

Transformation Focus

This leader will be expected to move beyond traditional application support and serve as an enterprise transformation partner. The VP will help the organization use Epic/Cerner, AI, automation, analytics, and workflow redesign to simplify care delivery, reduce administrative burden, improve throughput, strengthen access, enhance documentation quality, and optimize revenue cycle performance. The role requires the ability to translate strategic priorities into executable technology roadmaps and measurable operational outcomes.

Qualifications

Required Education:
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, healthcare administration, business administration, clinical discipline, or related field.

Required Experience / Skills:
10 years of progressive healthcare information technology leadership experience, including significant experience leading clinical applications in a hospital, integrated delivery network, academic medical center, or large health system environment. Experience with Epic/Cerner/Cerner, including leadership responsibility for Epic/Cerner/Cerner implementation, optimization, upgrades, application support, governance, or enterprise roadmap planning. Demonstrated experience supporting or transforming clinical workflows, revenue cycle operations, patient access, and interdisciplinary care delivery through technology-enabled change. Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams and manage complex portfolios of applications, projects, vendors, budgets, and operational priorities. Experience applying AI, automation, analytics, or intelligent workflow capabilities to improve healthcare operations, clinical effectiveness, or administrative productivity. Strong understanding of healthcare operations, clinical informatics, revenue cycle processes, interoperability, regulatory requirements, privacy, security, and enterprise change management. Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, clinicians, operational leaders, and technology teams through clear communication, collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and disciplined execution.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Director, Software Engineering will lead a globally distributed software engineering organization across the US, India, and Poland, setting technical direction and delivering scalable software solutions that create meaningful customer and business value. This role combines technical and organizational leadership across software architecture, engineering practices, AI-enabled development, and complex software platforms. The leader will partner across Product Management, Program Management, clinical teams, business stakeholders, and technology organizations to translate customer needs into engineering outcomes while balancing innovation, delivery, quality, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, privacy, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Lead a globally distributed software engineering organization across the US, India, and Poland, fostering collaboration, accountability, ownership, inclusion, continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
Define and execute an AI-first engineering strategy using AI-assisted development, automation, modern engineering practices, and emerging technologies to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and increase engineering productivity.
Establish technical standards, software architecture principles, engineering practices, and development methodologies that enable scalable, secure, reliable, maintainable, and extensible software solutions.
Provide technical leadership for complex software platforms spanning cloud, edge computing, distributed systems, data, analytics, and intelligent capabilities, guiding architecture and technical direction through strong software engineering and system design principles.
Lead engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through development, release, deployment, and operational support, while advancing cloud-native development, DevSecOps, automation, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and quality engineering practices.
Partner with Product Management, Program Management, clinical teams, Quality, Security, Regulatory, business stakeholders, and technology leaders to translate customer needs and feedback into prioritized engineering outcomes, manage dependencies, resolve technical trade-offs, and drive adoption and measurable business value.
Influence product roadmaps, technical strategy, architecture decisions, and investment priorities by balancing customer value, business objectives, technical sustainability, and engineering excellence.
Build and develop engineering leadership and technical talent through hiring, mentoring, and development of engineering managers and technical leaders, while establishing an effective global operating model and consistent engineering standards across regions.
Ensure software solutions meet GE HealthCare expectations for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, privacy, and operational excellence.
Communicate technology strategy, execution progress, risks, opportunities, recommendations, and business outcomes effectively with executive leadership, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field.
10+ years of software engineering experience, including designing, developing, and delivering scalable software platforms and enterprise applications.

Software Engineering & Architecture

Strong software development experience with object-oriented programming languages such as C++, Java, or similar technologies.
Proven experience designing and delivering distributed systems, cloud-based services, edge computing solutions, and scalable software architectures.
Deep understanding of software engineering principles, including object-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, API design, service-oriented architectures, and modern software development practices.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex software products from architecture and design through production deployment and operational support.
Ability to provide technical guidance, evaluate architecture decisions, and drive engineering excellence across teams.

Leadership & Collaboration

Significant experience leading software engineering organizations, including hiring, developing, mentoring, and retaining engineering managers and technical leaders.
Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Product Management, Program Management, Quality, Security, Regulatory, and business stakeholders.
Strong ability to influence without authority, build alignment, and drive execution across complex organizations.

Shape the future of software engineering at GE HealthCare by leading global engineering teams, advancing AI-first engineering practices, influencing technical direction, and delivering innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for patients, providers, and healthcare systems worldwide.

About Canopy Aerospace & Defense

Canopy A&D is built to accelerate the future of advanced materials for space, defense, and maritime systems. Canopy delivers specialized materials and components that carry customers from concept through sustainment. Canopy A&D’s advanced signal attenuation technologies and production-scale manufacturing accelerate the fielding of platforms that are faster, cooler, and quieter. Our adaptive approach ensures solutions evolve at the pace of shifting challenges, keeping our customers ahead of the curve.

Role Summary:

Canopy Aerospace & Defense is seeking a hands-on Director of Operational Technology to serve as second-in-command to the CIO and to own day-to-day manufacturing technology and IT operations from our Irvine, California facility. The OT environment is the center of gravity for this role: the machine-tool network, the controllers and inspection systems attached to it, and the segmentation and controls that keep that environment both running and compliant.

The successful candidate will be on the production floor and in the network room weekly — troubleshooting a controller segment, validating a restore, closing a control gap — while leading a team, managing vendors, owning a budget, and standing behind the environment during customer and third-party assessments. Uptime on the shop floor and demonstrable compliance are the same problem here, and this role owns both.

Key Responsibilities:

Operational Technology

Own the manufacturing network and every device on it: CNC and multi-axis machining centers, CMMs and metrology, thermal processing and coating equipment controls, PLCs, HMIs, SCADA and historian systems, test cells, and shop-floor data collection
Maintain an accurate, continuously updated OT asset inventory — controller model, OS and firmware version, network address, criticality, owner, and patch or compensating-control status
Design and enforce segmentation between enterprise and plant-floor zones using a defensible zone-and-conduit model (Purdue / ISA-95, IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82). Own the industrial DMZ and control every conduit that crosses it
Manage legacy and ‘unpatchable’ machine controllers through isolation, allowlisting, media control, jump-host access, monitoring, and documented compensating controls that survive assessor scrutiny
Own secure, controlled transfer of NC code, program files, and inspection data between engineering, ERP/PLM, and the shop floor — including removable-media policy and its technical enforcement
Set network, security, and remote-access requirements for new equipment at the purchase-specification stage, in partnership with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Facilities. Vendor remote access is a decision this role owns, not a concession made at installation
Own OT business continuity: controller images, post-processor and parameter backups, tested restores, and documented recovery objectives for production-critical systems

IT Operations

Own day-to-day IT service delivery for multiple sites — incidents, requests, change and problem management — and serve as senior escalation and, when needed, the person who does the work
Maintain up-time for systems that stop the line: ERP/MES, DNC and machine-tool file transfer, shop-floor data collection, quality and inspection systems, labeling and travelers, time and attendance
Own core infrastructure and its lifecycle: Windows Server and Active Directory, Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, virtualization, enterprise networking, storage, backup and disaster recovery, and endpoint management
Support the environments behind ERP, CAD/CAM, PLM, simulation, and metrology, including license servers, high-performance workstations, and large-file storage performance

Compliance — CMMC, ITAR and SOC 2

Continue to maintain and sustain compliance across CMMC, ITAR, and SOC 2 for both IT and OT scope — not a one-time certification push, but ongoing operation of the control set, evidence generation, and audit readiness as a standing condition of the environment
Sustain NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 technical controls across the CUI enclave including in-scope OT assets; own SSP contributions, POA&M closure, SPRS scoring inputs, annual affirmation support, and boundary scoping decisions defensible to a C3PAO, DIBCAC, or a prime’s supply-chain security team
Enforce ITAR and EAR technical-data controls in the technology environment: U.S. Person access restriction, data residency and tenancy controls, controlled sharing with customers and suppliers, and auditable access records
Support SOC 2 examinations and AS9100 surveillance by operating controls continuously and producing evidence on demand rather than assembling it retroactively
Lead technical incident response for the site — containment, eradication, recovery, forensic preservation, and the 72-hour DoD reporting workflow under DFARS 252.204-7012 — with the CIO, Legal, and the Facility Security Officer

Leadership

Lead, coach, staff, and hold accountable the site IT/OT team; act as the CIO’s deputy to site leadership, Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Finance
Manage MSP, VAR, and equipment-vendor relationships including service levels, security flow-downs, and performance escalation; own the site operating and capital technology budget

Required Qualifications:

Minimum 10 years in information or operational technology, including at least 4 years leading a team with direct-report and budget accountability
Minimum 5 years supporting discrete manufacturing; aerospace, defense, or another regulated manufacturing sector required
Demonstrated hands-on experience with OT / industrial control environments — machine-tool networks, PLC/HMI/SCADA, or shop-floor data collection. Governance-only OT exposure will not be competitive
Direct experience implementing and sustaining NIST SP 800-171 controls, and participation in at least one CMMC readiness effort, DIBCAC assessment, or equivalent third-party assessment of a defense environment
Working knowledge of DFARS 252.204-7012, SPRS scoring, CUI handling, and ITAR-controlled technical data in an IT/OT context
Ownership of ERP operations in manufacturing (Epicor or similar) and of ERP/MES/PLM integrations; core Microsoft and enterprise networking depth
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent additional directly relevant experience
U.S. Person requirement. Must be a U.S. Person as defined at 8 U.S.C
1324b(a)(3) and 22 C.F.R
120.62, and able to pass a background investigation. On-site in Irvine five days per week; after-hours and weekend support required

Preferred Qualifications:

Active or eligible U.S. Government security clearance (Secret or higher)
Experience with IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and Purdue/ISA-95 architecture applied to a live plant; OT-aware monitoring and asset discovery
Experience in Microsoft GCC High / Azure Government, and with a segmented CUI enclave that includes OT assets in scope
Multi-site or multi-entity manufacturing group experience; AS9100 and NADCAP familiarity; certifications such as GICSP, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CCNP, or CMMC RP/CCP

Additional Requirements

Must have professional working proficiency reading, writing, and speaking English
Ability to work in office, lab, and manufacturing environments with occasional exposure to noise, chemicals, dust, industrial equipment, and temperature variations
Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer workstation
Frequent use of hands and fingers for data entry, keyboarding, and mouse use
Ability to view computer screens for prolonged periods
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and via email
Ability to use a computer to complete assignments 
Willingness to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
Willingness to travel to other Canopy A&D sites as needed
